category: Personal brand, LinkedIn/X writing and carousel tools

competitors.name: Taplio
competitors.pricing: Starter $39/mo, Growth $69/mo, Pro $199/mo billed monthly (shown as '$', USD assumed). The same page's comparison table shows $32 / $49 / $149, unlabeled; Taplio's own Sep 2026 blog gives Starter $32/mo and Growth $49/mo annual. 7-day free trial with full Pro access, 30-day money-back. Multi-seat discount 'Save up to 30%'. AI writing is not on Starter; 250 AI credits + 500 comment credits/mo on Starter/Growth (mapping inferred), unlimited on Pro.
competitors.positioning: The 'full loop' LinkedIn growth tool: viral library, AI writing in your voice, scheduling, engagement feed and lead outreach in one app.
competitors.audience: LinkedIn creators, founders, B2B sales and ghostwriters (12k+ creators and teams claimed).

competitors.name: Supergrow
competitors.pricing: Pro $39/mo monthly or $31/mo annual (1 account); Teams $199/mo monthly or $189/mo annual (5 accounts); Enterprise custom. 7-day free trial. Third-party pages (Taplio blog Sep 2026, Tooliverse Jun 2026) also list a Starter at $19/mo ($16 annual, 2 PostCast sessions/mo) and Teams at $139/mo for 4 accounts; not on the vendor page fetched 2026-10-19.
competitors.positioning: 'AI that writes like you, not for you': LinkedIn content from AI interviews and a voice profile, with team approvals for executive programs.
competitors.audience: Founders, executives and B2B teams/agencies running several LinkedIn voices.

competitors.name: Kleo
competitors.pricing: $99/mo monthly, or $999/yr annual bundle ('Normally $1,188/yr'). '$' shown, USD assumed. No free trial; annual adds 1:1 onboarding call and 30-day risk-free guarantee.
competitors.positioning: Chat-first LinkedIn ghostwriter (Kleo V3 web app) bundled with templates, coaching and a creator community.
competitors.audience: Solo LinkedIn creators and consultants who want coaching plus an AI writer.

competitors.name: AuthoredUp
competitors.pricing: Individual $19.95/mo monthly or $16.63/mo billed $199.5/yr; Business $14.95 per profile/mo (min 3 profiles) or $12.46/profile/mo annual; Custom Growth plan (min 10 profiles) on request. Free trial, no card (length not stated).
competitors.positioning: LinkedIn editor, preview and analytics for people who write their own posts; deliberately no automation.
competitors.audience: Hands-on LinkedIn writers, ghostwriters and agencies (pay per profile, not per seat).

competitors.name: Typefully
competitors.pricing: Free plan (write in the editor, add images). Starter $12.50/mo per Typefully's own Dec 2025 blog. A Creator plan gates the Writing Assistant (Feb 2026 changelog); its price is unverified (third parties: $12.50/mo annual, $19/mo monthly). Team launched at a flat $49/mo in beta (2022); current Team price unverified. The pricing page did not render for fetching.
competitors.positioning: Distraction-free writer and scheduler for X, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon and Substack Notes, now agent-ready (API, MCP, Claude connector).
competitors.audience: Writers, founders and small teams posting across text-first networks.

competitors.name: Hypefury
competitors.pricing: Flexible $6/mo for 1 channel plus $6/mo per extra channel; Full $19/mo for all channels (Bluesky, Threads, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok). USD. 7-day free trial, no card. No free plan. X is no longer supported.
competitors.positioning: Automation-heavy creator scheduler (autoplugs, evergreen, auto-DMs, cross-posting) that has dropped X.
competitors.audience: Creators selling digital products who want growth automations across non-X networks.

competitors.name: Tweet Hunter
competitors.pricing: Discover $29/mo (1 X account), Grow $49/mo (5 accounts, AI writer, X CRM), Enterprise about $199-200/mo (unlimited accounts, custom-trained AI). Monthly prices; a yearly toggle advertises savings but shows no figures (third party: Discover $23/mo annual, unverified).
competitors.positioning: X growth suite: viral tweet library, AI writer, automations, auto-DM and an X CRM.
competitors.audience: X creators, founders and ghostwriters managing several X accounts.

competitors.name: EasyGen
competitors.pricing: Not published. The site says EasyGen 'has been acquired and isn't taking new signups'; existing customers can still log in.
competitors.positioning: LinkedIn writing tool built on creator analysis and trend intelligence; now closed to new users.
competitors.audience: LinkedIn creators (legacy customers only).

competitors.name: MagicPost
competitors.pricing: Growth $29/mo (yearly, 40% off list $49; $353/yr); Creator $39/mo (yearly, list $69; $468/yr); Agency and Team $47/seat/mo yearly (list $59), 5 seats = $295/mo or $2,830/yr; admin-only seats free. Free trial, no card, length varies by country. '$' shown, USD assumed.
competitors.positioning: LinkedIn AI writer plus engagement and lead detection on the official LinkedIn API, with agency approvals and white-label reports.
competitors.audience: LinkedIn creators, B2B sellers and agencies.

competitors.name: Postwise
competitors.pricing: Basic $37/mo (400 AI credits, 6 months scheduling, 5 accounts); Unlimited $97/mo paid annually (unlimited credits, scheduling, accounts). 7-day free trial.
competitors.positioning: AI ghostwriter and scheduler for X, LinkedIn and Threads.
competitors.audience: Creators posting text across X, LinkedIn and Threads.

competitors.name: ContentIn
competitors.pricing: Growth $39/mo monthly or $31/mo annual; Pro $59/mo monthly or $48/mo annual; Ghostwriter/Agency custom. 7-day trial with card, 30-day refund on first payment. No free plan on the vendor page (Taplio blog mentions a free scheduler, unverified).
competitors.positioning: Style-trained LinkedIn ghostwriter that plans your week every Sunday, with metered carousels and images.
competitors.audience: Founders and solo creators on LinkedIn; ghostwriters and agencies on custom plans.

competitors.name: Contentdrips
competitors.pricing: Free $0 (50 AI credits, 1 brand); Starter $15/mo (500 AI credits, 3 brands, 2 team members); Pro $26/mo (1,200 AI credits, unlimited brands and team). A second table on the same page lists Starter 1,500 credits, Pro 5,000 credits + API/MCP (6,000 calls) and Ultimate 8,000 credits + 25,000 API calls, without readable prices. Up to 20% off annual. 7-day free trial.
competitors.positioning: Template-driven carousel, quote and tweet-graphic maker with AI writing, bulk generation, scheduling and an API/MCP.
competitors.audience: LinkedIn and Instagram creators, agencies managing multiple brand kits, developers.

competitors.name: aiCarousels
competitors.pricing: Free $0 (basic use without sign-up); PRO $14.95/mo or $120/yr (third-party directory, verified 2026-03-22; the vendor pricing page returned 404). Another review lists $15/mo or $10/mo annual. Unverified on vendor site.
competitors.positioning: Cheap, fast AI carousel generator for LinkedIn, Instagram and TikTok with bonus post tools.
competitors.audience: Creators who need quick carousels without design skills.

competitors.name: PostNitro
competitors.pricing: Free (up to 5 AI slides, 5 downloads/mo, watermark); Starter $15/mo; Creator+ $30/mo; Team+ $60/mo. Yearly = 2 months free (figures not shown). API add-on $10/mo for 250 credits; 1 credit per imported slide, 2 per AI slide.
competitors.positioning: AI carousel and short-video post designer with brand kits, an in-canvas AI agent, scheduling to 6 networks and an MCP/CLI.
competitors.audience: Creators, agencies and platforms embedding a carousel editor (200+ platforms claimed).

competitors.name: Copy.ai
competitors.pricing: Chat $29/mo or $24/mo annual (5 seats, unlimited chat words); Growth $1,000/mo billed annually (75 seats, 20K workflow credits); Expansion $2,000/mo; Scale $3,000/mo; Enterprise custom.
competitors.positioning: Pivoted to a GTM AI platform (workflows for sales and marketing); social posting is generic chat plus Brand Voice and Infobase.
competitors.audience: Sales and marketing teams in mid-market and enterprise.

competitors.name: Jasper
competitors.pricing: Pro $69/seat/mo monthly or $59/seat/mo annual; Business custom (12-month minimum). 7-day free trial on Pro.
competitors.positioning: Enterprise marketing AI with brand voice, knowledge, style guides and 100+ agents; Remix mode repurposes content into social posts.
competitors.audience: Marketing teams that need on-brand content at scale.

competitors.name: Eden (2026 entrant)
competitors.pricing: Free $0; Starter $25/mo or $299/yr (200 AI credits, 10 tracked creators, 5 tracked brands); Pro $66/mo or $790/yr (750 credits, 40 creators, 25 brands); Max $167/mo or $1,999/yr (3,000 credits, 100 creators); Curator Personal $7.50/mo and Personal Plus $12.50/mo (page also says from $9). The homepage shows different figures ($9 Personal, $29 Starter). USD.
competitors.positioning: Creator OS: cross-platform outlier research, ad library, swipe boards, reverse-engineer-and-replicate drafting, scheduling, store and email.
competitors.audience: Creators and info-product sellers working across 7+ platforms.

competitors.name: Reepl (2026 entrant)
competitors.pricing: Pro / Premium / Max priced per seat per month with 4,000 / 10,000 / 25,000 credits; dollar amounts did not render. Pro Annual $200/yr. Premium trial 3 days for $1; 'Get started free'. Unverified monthly prices.
competitors.positioning: LinkedIn-first AI co-pilot with a voice profile, an agent (Andy), carousels, cross-posting to X and Threads and an in-feed reply extension.
competitors.audience: LinkedIn creators, teams and agencies.

competitors.name: ViralBrain (2026 entrant)
competitors.pricing: Free (3 hero profiles, 3 posts/mo, no auto-posting); Pro EUR 39/mo (20 posts/mo, 10 heroes, 5 carousels/mo); Premium EUR 69/mo (90 posts/mo, 30-day calendar, LinkedIn auto-posting). 7-day trial for EUR 1 (card required). Yearly = 2 months free.
competitors.positioning: Learn from 'hero' creators in your niche and apply their winning patterns in your voice, with a 30-day auto calendar.
competitors.audience: LinkedIn creators, priced in EUR (Europe-first).

competitors.name: Ordinal (2026 entrant)
competitors.pricing: Starter $95/mo ($85 annual), Pro $265/mo ($235 annual), Growth $695/mo ($625 annual), Enterprise custom. 4 social profiles per plan, extra $20/mo each; engagement-only profiles $10/mo; leads data add-on.
competitors.positioning: B2B LinkedIn and X publishing for teams: approvals, team engagement (likes, comments, reposts) and campaign calendars.
competitors.audience: B2B marketing teams, employee advocacy and agencies.

competitors.name: SuperX (2026 entrant)
competitors.pricing: Pro $49/mo; Advanced $49/mo launch price (normally $99/mo); Ultra $199/mo. No annual prices shown.
competitors.positioning: X growth OS: daily viral inspiration, ready-to-post AI queue, automations, engagement feed, Chrome analytics overlay and lead 'Signal Agents'.
competitors.audience: X creators, founders and ghostwriters.

competitors.name: koomastudio (2026 entrant)
competitors.pricing: Pro $12/mo founder price (rises to $24/mo when early-access spots fill); 3-day full Pro trial, no card.
competitors.positioning: Low-cost LinkedIn planner with a topic-by-format content matrix, compounding voice profile and branded carousels.
competitors.audience: Solo LinkedIn creators on a budget.

features.detail: Viral posts > 'For You' tab shows 5 new high-performing LinkedIn posts per day matched to your AI settings. Each card has a 'Why is this viral?' explanation plus 'Save' and 'Remix' buttons. 'Adjust AI' (top right) edits the matching fields: 'You write in', 'You work in', 'You are a', 'You want to reach', 'You post about'.
features.notable: Explaining WHY a post worked on the card itself, before the user remixes it; matching driven by a short profile.

features.detail: Search bar over a library of 4M+ posts (help center) / '5M+ Inspiration & viral posts' (pricing page). Accepts a topic, idea or full sentence; suggested topic cards run a search in one click. After a search, filters appear: 'Published on', 'Content', 'Creator', 'Keywords', 'Clear all', 'Sort by'. A third tab, 'Saved posts', holds bookmarks.
features.limits_or_cost: Library size differs by page (4M+ vs 5M+).
features.notable: Sentence-level semantic search plus suggested topic cards lowers the blank-search problem.

features.detail: 'Save' bookmarks any library post into 'Saved posts'; posts can be grouped into Collections. The free Chrome extension adds 'Save post' from inside LinkedIn.
features.limits_or_cost: Extension is free and works without a plan.

features.detail: Flow: pick a post in 'For You' or 'Explore more' -> click 'Remix' -> a variation starts streaming on the 'Ask Taplio' page -> 'Open in composer' -> refine with 'AI options' or generate an image from the post content -> schedule or publish now.
features.limits_or_cost: AI features on Growth and Pro only.
features.notable: Remix lands in a chat surface first, then the composer, so the user can iterate before editing.

features.detail: Ask Taplio starter suggestion 'Remix my posts that worked' and the composer slash command '/repurpose' rewrite the user's own past winners into fresh variations in their voice. The Remix button also works on the user's own posts.
features.notable: Recycling your own proven posts is a low-risk remix source.

features.feature: AI profile ('Adjust AI') as voice and strategy
features.detail: Four-step setup: 'About you' (pulled from LinkedIn, editable), 'Tone of Voice', 'Content pillars', 'Audience'. These settings shape every idea, draft and the daily viral matches. Homepage says Taplio also learns voice from your posts and edits.
features.notable: One short profile feeds inspiration matching, ideas and drafting at once.

features.detail: Chat assistant that 'has read every post you wrote' and 'knows what LinkedIn rewards this month'. Starter prompts: 'What's working in my niche', 'What worked this month', 'Remix my posts that worked'. Homepage shows a weekly brief of trends with percentage lifts (e.g. 'Founder-led sales past 1M ARR' +212%) and an action 'Draft a post on trend 2, in your voice'.
features.limits_or_cost: Weekly trend brief is 'Request early access' (unverified availability).
features.notable: Trend brief with one-tap 'draft on trend N in my voice' is a proactive next-up pattern.

features.detail: Write & Schedule > Post builder. Tab 'From an idea': enter a topic (or 'Suggest topic'), tick one or more variations (Actionable, Storytelling, Thought-provoking, Promotional), optional Format & tone panel ('Edit'), then 'Generate posts'. Tab 'From a URL': choose 'Article' or 'YouTube Video', paste link, 'Generate'.
features.limits_or_cost: Each generated version uses '1 Expert Mode credit'.
features.notable: Generating several angle variants at once (story vs actionable vs promo) lets the user pick rather than prompt.

features.feature: Composer AI edits and slash commands
features.detail: Composer 'AI Edit' tab: 'Improve this post', 'Rewrite the hook', 'Fix grammar and spelling', or a custom instruction. 'Adjust results' fine-tunes output and 'History' restores earlier versions. Slash commands '/postIdeas' (ideas from profile, recent posts and inspiration) and '/repurpose'. Homepage mockup also shows 'Rewrite hook', 'Make it a story', 'My tone'.
features.limits_or_cost: Growth/Pro; 250 AI credits/mo on Starter/Growth (inferred), unlimited on Pro.
features.notable: Version history on AI rewrites protects the user's work.

features.detail: Homepage lists 'Live reach prediction before you publish' in the composer.
features.notable: Pre-publish score nudges edits before posting.

features.detail: Write & Schedule > Carousel Generator. Start 'From scratch/blank page', from AI input ('Generate Carousel'), or from a website or YouTube URL (slides filled with highlighted text from the source). Suggested structure: slide 1 hook, body slides, final CTA; 7-10 slides advised. Tabs: 'Content' (images), 'Settings' (text formatting), 'Color Palette' or 'Use custom colors' (hex), 'Preview', drag to reorder, 'Reset'. Finish with 'Save for later' (to 'My Carousels'), 'Create Post' (names it and attaches to composer) or 'Download' (PDF). Third-party: also imports tweets, Reddit posts and images, adds profile picture and handle.
features.limits_or_cost: Growth/Pro (AI tools count against AI credits). Cannot import an existing PDF; upload PDFs in the post editor instead. PDF export only.
features.notable: URL or YouTube -> carousel, then one click to attach to a scheduled post.

features.detail: AI image generation from the post content, offered in the composer 'AI options' and listed as an AI tool on pricing.
features.limits_or_cost: Counts against AI credits (250/mo Starter/Growth inferred; unlimited Pro).

features.detail: Actions > 'Edit Post schedule': pick a time and 'Add slot' (advice: at least one slot every day, vary times). Add posts to the next slot in one click. Queue controls: 'Re-queue' (pull scheduled posts up to fill gaps), 'Shuffle' (mix order), 'Edit queue'. Day view by default; icon switches to a monthly calendar where clicking a slot creates a post. Homepage also claims 'Best-time scheduling tuned to your followers'.
features.notable: Shuffle and Re-queue keep a batch-written week evenly spread.

features.detail: Drafts can be viewed as a Kanban board; reusable 'Snippets'; LinkedIn polls; @mentions of people and companies; posting as a company page; text formatting and media assets library.

Composer 'Boosts' tab per post: 'Remove URL previews'; 'Scheduled comment' (e.g. link in first comment, optional delay, saved links); 'Auto Connect' (connection requests to likers/commenters, capped per post); 'Auto Reply' (reply to commenters, optional keyword trigger); 'Auto DM' (personalized DM with first name/company to likers or repliers, usually within an hour); 'Also Publish on X' via Tweet Hunter (next slot or same time, 280-char edit).
features.limits_or_cost: Auto DM: 1st-degree connections only, stops 24h after publishing, only first 100 engagers. Auto-reply monitoring 2 days (Starter/Growth, inferred) vs 90 days (Pro). Auto-add likers/commenters 20 per post (inferred) vs unlimited (Pro).
features.notable: Keyword comment -> auto DM a resource is the lead magnet loop, configured per post at scheduling time.

features.feature: Engage: Comments tab with Smart Replies
features.detail: Engage > Comments. 'My Posts Comments' loads comments on posts published via Taplio. 'Smart Replies' suggests replies in four tones: 'Add Value', 'Congratulate', 'Agree', 'Disagree'. Snippets and emojis; 'Like & Skip'; 'Auto-Like' when you reply; 'View on LinkedIn'. 'Search by URL' + 'Retrieve Comments' pulls the last 500 comments of any public post.
features.limits_or_cost: Only posts published through Taplio; refresh every ~2 hours ('Refresh' to force). Search by URL is Pro only, 500 comments max. 500 comment credits/mo on Starter/Growth (inferred).
features.notable: Four fixed reply intents make AI comments fast to choose and less generic.

features.feature: Engage: Influencers and Custom lists feeds
features.detail: Engage > 'Influencers' shows recent posts from curated niche lists (e.g. 'Accounting', 'Artificial Intelligence', 'DACH Influencers'); 'Custom lists' shows posts from people in your own Contacts lists. Per post: type a reply, 'Smart Reply' (Add value / Congratulate / Agree / Disagree), Snippet, Emoji; quick actions 'Like', 'Open', 'Copy', 'Skip', 'Like & Skip'.
features.limits_or_cost: Not real-time: most posts appear in 30-60 minutes, sometimes hours.
features.notable: A focused feed of chosen people replaces doom-scrolling LinkedIn.

features.feature: Auto lists of likers and commenters (CRM)
features.detail: Contacts lists 'Liked My Posts' and 'Commented My Posts' fill automatically; both exportable for outreach. Past interactions import gradually over the first week; new posts are fetched about 24h after publishing, then rechecked every few days.
features.limits_or_cost: Pacing is deliberate to 'limit the risks for your account'.
features.notable: Engagers become a reusable audience list without manual work.

features.detail: Prospect Hub > Lead database: 3M+ enriched LinkedIn profiles. Describe the audience in 'Describe what you're looking for' (AI sets filters) or 'Or search manually' with profile filters (location, job title, follower count, post topics, 30-day engagement, industry, seniority, department) and company filters (name, tags, headcount). Actions: 'Add to list', CSV export, 'Push to lemlist', DM or connection request from the side panel.
features.notable: Natural-language-to-filters search.

features.feature: Networking: bulk DMs and connection requests
features.detail: Networking > 'Get started'. 'Send personalized DMs in bulk': recipients from a contact list, a LinkedIn account, and/or people who engaged with a post; variables via '[' ([firstname], [company], [title], [city]); options 'Skip recipients with unfilled variables', 'Skip non-connected recipients'; 'Send Messages' or 'Schedule Messages'. Non-connections get a connection request first, DM after acceptance. 'Send bulk connection requests' skips existing/pending.
features.limits_or_cost: 100 DMs/day (overflow queued), 20 connection requests per working day. Auto-DM, bulk DMs and auto-connect listed under Pro outreach.

features.feature: Analytics, monthly email and LinkedIn Benchmark
features.detail: Post and account analytics, a monthly stats email, and 'LinkedIn Benchmark' (60k+ posts analyzed monthly) on every plan. Chrome extension shows 'My analytics'.
features.notable: Benchmark against a large monthly sample gives context to a user's own numbers.

features.detail: Lets Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or another MCP client find posts, draft comments and replies and queue them; images and videos can be attached to drafts. Nothing posts until the user confirms. '27 tools'. Also a Taplio API and Zapier integration.
features.notable: Human-confirm gate on every agent action.

features.detail: 7-day free trial with full Pro access, 30-day money-back, cancel in Settings > Billing. Taplio Academy masterclasses and live group demos. Credits: 250 AI credits and 500 comment credits per month on lower plans (mapping inferred), unlimited on Pro.
features.notable: Trial on the TOP tier so users feel the full product, then downgrade.

features.detail: Builds a voice profile from your existing LinkedIn posts, writing samples and profile: vocabulary, tone, opinions, known topics, hooks and pillars. Drafts are generated in that voice. Teams plan keeps a separate Content DNA per team member.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro: 1 account; Teams: per member (5 accounts).
features.notable: Capturing OPINIONS and known topics, not just tone, so drafts sound like the person's views.

features.detail: Voice or text conversation with an AI interviewer named 'Alex'. A 10-15 minute session (sources vary: 15-20) asks adaptive questions and turns the stories and takeaways into several LinkedIn drafts in your voice ('a week's worth of LinkedIn content'). Teams can 'Push Postcast interviews to team'.
features.limits_or_cost: Unlimited on Pro. Third-party: Starter capped at 2 sessions/mo. Output 3-7 drafts per session (sources disagree).
features.notable: Interview-to-posts removes the blank page for experts who will talk but not write; strong fit for financial advisers.

features.detail: Paste a YouTube video, blog/article or PDF and get 'multiple post formats from a single source' in your voice.
Speak an idea; AI turns the voice note into a post in your voice.
Drag-and-drop Kanban with stages 'Draft', 'Review', 'Approved', 'Scheduled'.
features.notable: Approval stage built into the board, not a separate tool.

features.feature: Scheduling, calendar and auto first comment
features.detail: Weekly calendar view with posts at peak times; 'Schedule First Comment' auto-publishes a follow-up comment (CTA, hashtags, context) when the post goes live; reusable snippets.

Carousel maker included on Pro. Third-party descriptions: drag-and-drop editor, 50+ mobile-first templates, inline click-to-edit text, image library, per-workspace brand kit (logos, colors, fonts), direct publish to LinkedIn, conversion 'in under 30 seconds'; infographic generator also listed.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro and up. Template count and brand kit unverified on vendor page.

features.feature: Engage with Focus Mode and AI comments
features.detail: 'Engage' gives a curated engagement feed; 'Focus Mode' lets you comment without the LinkedIn feed; AI comment drafts in your voice. Third-party: scheduled auto-comments based on engagement.

Dashboard of post performance, engagement and follower growth, AI analysis of what worked, and a weekly briefing that explains results ('Insights & Analytics'). Teams get per-member and team-wide weekly reports.
features.notable: A written weekly explanation, not just charts.

features.detail: Teams plan: 'Feedback & approval workflows' (review chain), 'Organisation dashboard', 'Share inspiration across workspaces', 'Content calendar across all members', 'Push content to all team workspaces', 'Publish on behalf of team members', role-based permissions.
features.notable: Push one piece of content into every member's workspace to adapt in their own voice: an employee-advocacy remix.

features.detail: 'Challenges & leaderboard' with streaks and ranks to drive adoption; Slack notifications.
features.notable: Gamified posting streaks for teams of advisers.

features.detail: Connects Claude or ChatGPT to draft posts, pull analytics and manage teams from one prompt; example tool 'get_team_analytics'.

Drafting starts in a chat ('What are we creating today?'). Kleo turns rough ideas into drafts and explains why a post is structured as it is (hook, angle, structure). 'Preview and edit' before publishing.
features.notable: Explaining the hook/angle/structure teaches the user while drafting.

features.detail: 'Train writing style' from samples of your past posts or frameworks from popular creators (vocabulary, sentence rhythm, hook style). 'Automatic memories' learn from each post you create and persist across sessions.
features.notable: Voice that keeps learning from every accepted post.

features.detail: 'Store knowledge': reusable case studies, frameworks, client wins the AI draws on. 'Define identity': who you are, what you stand for and who you address; included in every prompt.
features.notable: Separate 'facts I can cite' store from 'voice'.

features.detail: 'Browse swipe file' of curated high-performing content; 'Save inspiration' from across the web. The Chrome extension captures posts and ideas from social media, web pages and blogs into your swipe file, where you can turn them into ideas, drafts, remixes and posts. The extension no longer acts inside LinkedIn.

'Use templates': 160+ plug-and-play post templates, 200+ hook templates (grouped by style: curiosity, contrarian, story-opener, list-promise), 170+ top-performing post swipes, 20 viral post prompts, 20 lead-gen prompts, engagement and strategy playbooks.
One-click visuals generated to match the post.
features.limits_or_cost: 20 graphics per month, even on the top plan.

features.detail: Calendar with drag-and-drop queuing; posts publish to LinkedIn at the scheduled time.
Post generation in English (UK/US), German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch, Danish, Czech.
Fast start video training, weekly live group coaching, private creator community; annual adds 1:1 onboarding call and marketing team sessions.
features.notable: Selling outcomes (coaching) with the tool justifies a high price.

features.feature: Extension shut down by LinkedIn (platform risk)
features.detail: Kleo 1.0 was a free Chrome extension inside LinkedIn with 70,000+ users; LinkedIn required its removal (June 2025 per MagicPost; cease-and-desist per AuthoredUp review) and the team rebuilt as a paid web app (Kleo V3). Multi-profile support is 'coming soon'.
features.notable: Lesson: avoid features that automate inside LinkedIn's UI; use official APIs.

features.detail: Write inside LinkedIn (extension) or on the web platform: bold, italic, bullet and list styles, emoji; mentions of people and companies; attachments (images, GIFs, video, docs, polls, events); 'Multi-device preview'.
features.limits_or_cost: Video, polls and events publish through the extension.

features.detail: Shows a readability grade and character/length insights as you write; guidance suggests aiming for grade 8 or lower.
features.notable: A simple, explainable quality score on the draft.

features.detail: Pick a hook (opening line) or ending/CTA template to insert into the post. 'Hooks library (200+ opening lines)' (pricing cards say 300+) and 'CTA & post-ending templates (150+)'.
features.notable: Insert-from-library at the exact spot in the editor.

features.detail: Save and reuse signatures, hashtags or any text block.
Collects LinkedIn posts you saved, including ones saved before installing the extension; filter by keyword or author; export to CSV for analysis in Excel, ChatGPT or Claude.
features.notable: Imports the user's existing LinkedIn saves, so the swipe file starts full on day one.

features.feature: Drafts with stages, tags and share-for-review
features.detail: Unlimited drafts; tag drafts and move them through stages 'Active', 'Ready', 'Submitted'; 'Share a draft for review' via read-only link; draft collaboration in Business.
features.notable: Read-only review link works for a compliance reviewer without a seat.

features.detail: 'Content calendar (profiles, pages & groups)', scheduling (through the extension), 'Reminders to post & engage', 'Best time to post (from your own posts)', activity chart for consistency, weekly goal tracker.
Suggests three past posts worth reusing, chosen by engagement rate or impressions; 'One-click reuse' opens one as a new draft.
features.notable: Evergreen recycling of the user's own winners.

features.detail: 'Performance dashboard', 'Profile growth timeline', 'Performance snapshot (this period vs last)', 'Breakdown: best post type, day, length & readability' (avg reactions by Text, Reshare, Image, Document, Link, Poll), 'Side-by-side post comparison', 'Advanced metrics: saves, sends, reach, profile views & followers gained', which posts bring followers, word cloud of themes.
features.limits_or_cost: Advanced metrics for personal profile posts.
